g.text: Bachelor’s employment stocks by age and exposure
Fixed 2025 exposure quintiles, annual survey-weighted employed-person stocks.
These aggregate indices are distinct from the within-high-exposure, trend-adjusted regression.
The 40–54 negative regression break coexists with a rising employment stock.
